title: Decide whether an alias may move
description: Select a change, collect required evidence, bound the rollout, and inject a handoff failure. The alias moves only after the release decision is reproducible.

changes.label: Routine retrain
changes.detail: The feature and serving contracts are unchanged, but data and model behavior moved.

changes.label: Feature contract change
changes.detail: Input schema, preprocessing, producers, and serving consumers must move together.

changes.label: MLflow and model rebuild
changes.detail: Tracking schema, client compatibility, package metadata, and serving behavior may all change.

handoffs.label: Resolve alias once
handoffs.detail: The deployment controller resolves champion, records the immutable version, and deploys that version.

handoffs.label: Poll alias at runtime
handoffs.detail: Serving workers can silently load different versions as the mutable alias changes.

gates.label: Lineage complete
gates.detail: Run, dataset, code, parameters, and package can be traced end to end.

gates.label: Signature compatible
gates.detail: Inputs, outputs, defaults, and serving examples match consumers.

gates.label: Evaluation reproduced
gates.detail: Overall and slice metrics come from a versioned evaluation dataset.

gates.label: Dependencies reviewed
gates.detail: Resolved dependencies and bundled code pass policy and vulnerability checks.

gates.label: Serving smoke test
gates.detail: The packaged model loads and answers valid and invalid payloads in a clean runtime.

gates.label: Consumer contract
gates.detail: Feature producers and inference clients accept the new schema.

gates.label: Migration backup
gates.detail: Tracking metadata and artifact references can be restored after schema migration.

gates.label: Client compatibility
gates.detail: Pinned training, evaluation, and deployment clients pass against the target server.

gates.label: Observability ready
gates.detail: Version, alias resolution, model quality, latency, errors, and rollback signals are queryable.

gates.label: Rollback rehearsed
gates.detail: The previous immutable version remains loadable and routing can return to it.

failures.label: No injected failure
failures.detail: Review evidence and rollout scope before promotion.
failures.containment: Keep the alias unchanged until every required gate passes.

failures.label: Artifact unavailable
failures.detail: The deployment controller cannot fetch the candidate package.
failures.signal: Artifact download or checksum verification fails before startup.
failures.containment: Abort the candidate and keep serving the already loaded champion version.

failures.label: Schema rejection spike
failures.detail: Canary requests fail model signature or consumer contract checks.
failures.signal: Validation errors rise only for the candidate version and payload shape.
failures.containment: Set candidate traffic to zero and retain rejected payload samples without sensitive values.

failures.label: Concurrent alias update
failures.detail: Another release moves champion after this decision read the old pointer.
failures.signal: The expected champion version no longer matches the registry response.
failures.containment: Fail the compare step, refresh evidence, and never overwrite the newer promotion blindly.
